# Devices & notifications
{: .no_toc }

Where push notifications reach this person, and controls for this device.
{: .fs-6 .fw-300 }

| | |
|---|---|
| **Screen ID** | `NTF-03` |
| **Route** | `/account/devices` · deep link `substratal://account/devices` |
| **Where** | Personal › Account |
| **Who can use it** | Self |
| **Kind** | settings |
| **Available in** | All Hub apps (Phase 2) |
| **On Linux** | `AdwPreferencesPage` |

## What's on this screen

| Element | What it is | Shows / does | Rules | On Linux |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| This device | card | Hub Device for this install (matched by stored device id) | status, "Notifications are on" / off / blocked by OS; button Turn on (→ NTF-04) or Turn off | .card box |
| Push notifications (all apps) | toggle | Settings.notifications.push | same control as SET-01 | AdwSwitchRow |
| Devices | list | Device: name, application_id (app icon), provider, environment, status, inactive_reason, last_registered_at, last_delivery_at, token_hint | grouped by app; inactive rows dimmed with reason ("Signed out", "Not opened in 9 months"…) | GtkListBox .boxed-list |
| Rename | row-button | PATCH /users/me/devices/{deviceId} {name} |  | suffix GtkButton .flat |
| Send test notification | row-button | POST /users/me/devices/{deviceId}/test | Hub devices only; shows provider result inline (sent / failed + error) within 10 s | suffix GtkButton .flat |
| Remove | row-button | DELETE /users/me/devices/{deviceId} | confirm; that install stops receiving pushes until it registers again | suffix GtkButton .flat |

## What happens when you act

| Action | API call | Result |
|---|---|---|
| Turn off on this device | `DELETE /users/me/devices/{deviceId}` | and stop re-registering until the user turns it back on |
| Test | `POST /users/me/devices/{deviceId}/test` | 429 → "Try again later (10 tests per hour)"; 409 push_not_configured → "Push isn't set up for this app yet" |

## Good to know

- **Loading, empty and error states:** Loading: skeleton after 300 ms; Error: inline with Retry; codes per COPY-AND-STATES
- Device tokens are never displayed (only token_hint).

## For developers

Loads: `GET /users/me/devices?include_inactive=true` · `GET /users/me/settings (notifications.push)`

Every call sends `Substratal-Version: 1` to `https://api.substratalapps.com` (no `/v1` in the path). See [API versioning]({{ '/api/versioning/' | relative_url }}) and the [API reference]({{ '/api/reference/' | relative_url }}).
